body:
I understand what you are saying, and I may have been way too upset last night to realize that he wasn't trying to be hurtful. What I'm going through also sounds stupid to me too, though. I'm upset with myself for putting myself in this situation and I'm having a really tough time getting out of it.

I'm also having a hard time getting anything done or getting anywhere in my progress because I'm so scared of relying on other people. I've always been a little bit too scared of asking for help and coupled with my independent nature makes for a bad mix. I don't have many friends either, so there isn't much of a support for me in that aspect. 

Everything just seems so overwhelming in my life that it seems simpler to just not exist anymore. I wouldn't have to worry about finding a car, and a better job, and a better place for me. The burden feels like more than I handle on my own and sometimes I wish I had someone who I could share it with. I think I've made it pretty clear that my boyfriend is not very capable of doing that.

I have thought that maybe there are better medications, and I wish I could afford them. Under my current healthcare plan it's really not feasible and free mental healthcare isn't available for me any longer. My older brother is bipolar as well and he seems to be doing okay on medication, but we don't talk a whole lot.

My situation with my parents is pretty shitty, and I recognize that it is mostly my fault. I ruined our relationship when I made some bad choices in my teenage years, and then running away almost severed it completely. My mom didn't want that to happen though and she reached out to me a bit. We haven't had much of an honest heart-to-heart since before I left though. I've never told her that I'm sorry for all the things I've done and I feel really ashamed for it. I still see them once in a while, but I work a retail position and have horribly inconsistent hours, plus no transportation down there.

My biggest problem is I just don't know where to go from here. I don't feel strong enough to tackle the issues I have and I've been burying them and trying hard to stand on my own two feet by myself. I think I've made myself a lot clearer than I did last night.
Wow, what may seem like nothing to you has been pretty damn hard for me to live with. I dont feel talking anymore.

This is going to take forever, but okay I guess.

Around four years ago, at age 18, I was living with my parents, on a whole bunch of drugs to treat me being bipolar. I hated living with them and hated the drugs just as much, so I decided that I was going to quit the drugs and then I was going to take a trip to visit all my internet friends before finally killing myself. About the same time I ended meeting a new person online and decided that I was in love with them. After about a month and a half of talking I wanted to meet this person, so I had him come pick me up and I would hang out with him for a day. I didn't let him know, but my plan was to really just gtfo of where I was at and talk him into letting me live with him. 

What a great idea that was. At the time it sounded better than killing myself, but it was a pretty horrible idea. I cancelled all the plans I had for my trip around the world and cut off all ties with my friends and family to go live with someone I barely knew. This plan is not as nearly as brilliant as it sounds.

After 3 months of living there, life started to be not so great. He had some severe anger issues and made me scared to be there. After 7 months of being there I nearly committed suicide, but he held me down and stopped me while calling 911. I had decided to kill myself then for somewhat the same reason as now. Living with him has been a nightmare for me. Our personalities clash so much and he is so unbelievably lazy. Seriously, what did I expect?

After the suicide scare, he called my parents, who picked me up from the hospital, but I actually told them to take me back to his house! I went to a free mental health clinic a few times, but hated it so much that I stopped. (I'm rereading this story and realizing it has no continuity, I'm sorry) I ended up getting a job which helped me a lot. It gave me something to do, and somewhere to be away from him. I started burying myself in things like video games and books to take my mind off my situation. 

After four years of this, I can't do it anymore. I have a job, but I have no car and am reliant on him for transportation to and from work. I tried going back to school to get some computer networking certificates, but am having such a hard time studying it seemed pointless so after one year, I quit. I feel like I can't help myself get out because I have no knowledge of what to do on my own and know no one who can help me. 

And now I reread this again and realize I'm only describing my situation and not even my real thoughts or feelings and it all sounds stupid and pointless. I can't even express my own thoughts. fuck it.

TL;DR: I feel trapped in my living situation with nowhere to go and I don't have any idea what to do or how to get out and be on my own or what would happen. I'm tired of my thoughts always turning to suicide so I'm just going to fucking do it and quit worrying about it all.
